name: Nitrous
author: Max (byzyn4ik)
description: Fast & Furious' nitrous in Forza Horizon 2: hold the left stick click (or Left Shift) with the throttle down for a torque boost from a tank that refills. Uses the nitrous model Forza Horizon 2's car physics still has; only the player's car. With Fast & Furious' exhaust flames, pad rumble, camera layers and NOS sounds (the last two made from your own copy of the game); the gauge is drawn by Performance.
